## Lesson 5 — Change capacitance on the same Plan {#lesson-change-capacitance}

**Prerequisite:** run Lessons 1–4 in the aggregate Chapter Notebook.

A `ParameterSet` selects 120 fF for the already-bound capacitor. Compare its S11 with the 110 fF baseline on the same Plan; the parameter selection does not construct a second circuit.

```{python}
#| id: ch1-select-capacitance
selected_parameters = ParameterSet({capacitance: 120.0 * u.fF})
```

Use the same frequency grid, sealed Run, original View, and Direct request.

```{python}
#| id: ch1-solve-selected-s11
selected_response = run.solve(
    run.original,
    direct_spec,
    parameters=selected_parameters,
)
```

```{python}
#| id: ch1-show-selected-s11
from IPython.display import display

baseline_magnitude = baseline_response.s.plot(component="magnitude", magnitude="db")
selected_magnitude = selected_response.s.plot(component="magnitude", magnitude="db")
baseline_phase = baseline_response.s.plot(component="phase")
selected_phase = selected_response.s.plot(component="phase")
magnitude_plot = baseline_magnitude
phase_plot = baseline_phase
for figure, extra, component, unit in (
    (magnitude_plot, selected_magnitude, "magnitude", "dB"),
    (phase_plot, selected_phase, "phase", "deg"),
):
    baseline_trace = figure.data[0]
    baseline_trace.name = "110 fF baseline"
    baseline_trace.line.color = "#246398"
    baseline_trace.showlegend = True
    selected_trace = extra.data[0]
    selected_trace.name = "120 fF selected"
    selected_trace.line.color = "#b54b35"
    selected_trace.showlegend = True
    figure.add_trace(selected_trace)
    figure.update_layout(
        template="plotly_white", autosize=True, height=360,
        title={"text": f"S11 {component}", "x": 0.02, "xanchor": "left"},
        font={"family": "Arial, sans-serif", "size": 14, "color": "#243344"},
        margin={"l": 78, "r": 24, "t": 55, "b": 62},
        paper_bgcolor="white", plot_bgcolor="white",
    )
    figure.update_xaxes(title_text="Frequency (GHz)", automargin=True)
    figure.update_yaxes(title_text=f"{component.capitalize()} ({unit})", automargin=True)
magnitude_plot.update_yaxes(range=[-0.05, 0.05])
display(magnitude_plot)
display(phase_plot)
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

Baseline is 110 fF and the selected parameter point is 120 fF; both traces are at Port 1, `signal_in`.

Evaluate the same loaded-root request at the selected point.

```{python}
#| id: ch1-evaluate-selected-root
selected_root = run.evaluate(
    root_view,
    root_spec,
    parameters=selected_parameters,
)
```

```{python}
#| id: ch1-show-selected-root
display(selected_root.frequency)
display(selected_root.linewidth)
selected_root.plot()
```

The generated quantity table reports both loaded Results beside the separate
unloaded LC calculation. It does not infer a dip from the nearly flat ideal
one-port magnitude.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

{{< include ../figures/01-quantities.md >}}

[Download the baseline/selected quantity table](../figures/01-quantities.csv).

:::

Changing the selected physical capacitance shifts the phase feature and loaded
root without redefining the circuit. The Plan, request, parameter point, and
each Result retain separate identities.
